# Advice Lab

## Overview
Advice Lab is an Australian financial services support business helping Australian advisers with offshore paraplanning, client support, SMSF & accounting, and mortgage support.

Website:
- https://advicelab.com.au/

## Mission
Advice Lab’s mission is to help Australian financial advisers grow better, with dependable outsourced back-office support and a people-first approach.

## Core values
- Integrity
- Accountability
- Quality
- Compliance
- Initiative

## Services
### Paraplanning
- Statement of Advice (SOA) preparation
- Record of Advice (ROA) preparation
- Client file management and reviews
- Research and strategy analysis
- Portfolio reviews and comparisons
- Compliance documentation support

### Client Support
- Review pack preparation and management
- Advice document preparation
- Application and implementation support
- Provider management and follow-ups
- Compliance and verification support
- Client lifecycle and digital workflow management

### SMSF & Accounting
- SMSF annual financial statements
- Fund administration and compliance
- Bookkeeping and reconciliations
- Payroll and BAS support
- Tax return preparation and lodgment support
- Audit coordination and support

### Mortgage Support
- Loan application processing
- Document verification and collection
- Lender communication and follow-ups
- Settlement coordination
- Property and valuation support
- Refinancing assistance

## Brand / positioning
Advice Lab supports financial advisers with reliable offshore back-office support, helping them reduce admin burden, improve turnaround times, and maintain quality and compliance.

## Compliance and trust
- ISO 27001 certified for information security
- Works with advisers across Australia
- Teams in Sri Lanka and the Philippines support extended hours
